set.body: Implement PRD RA-2 and RA-4 through RA-7. TraceSource determines result type: sample exposure and clipped fixation dwell use NonNegativeSpan, fixation onsets use non-negative counts. EventAllocation separates selection from clipped-intersection versus whole-at-onset contribution. Exclusive and multiple spatial membership return different accounting records. Coverage names background, off-screen, blink, lost, ambiguity, fixation, saccade, pursuit, unsegmented time, sample support, and overlap multiplicity as applicable.
set.title: Entity-primary exposure, dwell, and onset traces
